items.title: Asterisk — IP Telephony
items.description: Implementation of an internal IP telephony system based on Asterisk, an open-source PBX, running on Linux. The project includes SIP account and dial plan configuration, call queues, voicemail, call transfers, and connections between internal extensions and external lines through a SIP trunk. It also covers SIP security with Fail2ban and IP restrictions, as well as call monitoring through CDR logs.

items.title: Remote network control
items.description: Development of a remote administration tool for monitoring and controlling machines on a local network through a centralized Node.js interface. The system can execute commands, check device status and resources, and manage multiple machines simultaneously through real-time socket communication.

items.title: Clinic management system
items.description: Desktop clinic management application developed in C++ with Qt 6. It covers patients, appointments, medical records, and billing.

items.title: Professional appointments (mobile)
items.description: React Native mobile application built with Expo, connected to a PHP/PDO API and a MySQL/MariaDB database. It allows clients to find workers, check availability, book a time slot, and leave a review.

items.title: SPEED — Customs monitoring
items.description: Web application for monitoring customs performance, built with React, Node.js/Express, and MySQL/MariaDB. It provides JWT authentication, management of manifests, goods, declarations, auctions, and disputes, along with statistical dashboards and admin forecasts.
